applicability_update: Owner selected Xbox One S as the target. This 1914 record is a legacy cross-model reference.

source.kind: First-hand disassembly guide; not manufacturer dimensional CAD
source.author: yoeri and contributors

observations.finding: Stick caps are removable; the D-pad is retained by a metal ring.
observations.model_consequence: Do not interpret separate direction-labeled visual meshes as four independent physical plungers.

observations.finding: Trigger caps are fastened with screws; small rumble motors are located in the triggers.
observations.model_consequence: A uniform-density cap alone does not establish the moving assembly inertia.

observations.finding: Buttons become loose after board removal, are keyed for placement, and incorrect Y placement can interfere with RT travel.
observations.model_consequence: Button orientation and button-trigger clearance require checks, not only independent joint travel tests.

harness_requirements.status: Not implemented: requires mechanism geometry and source-to-physical registration
harness_requirements.dpad: Check coupled pad movement and switch activation, not four separately animated meshes
harness_requirements.triggers: Account for all moving components before validating inertia
harness_requirements.clearance: Sweep Y and RT through measured or source-backed limits; inspect interference
